Implemented the Dashboard in [Dashboard.tsx](/workspace/app/Dashboard.tsx). It fetches all three endpoints in parallel, displays each response as formatted JSON, and shows loading or error feedback per section. The requests are cancelled if the component unmounts.

I didn’t run tests or type checks. The API response shapes aren’t defined in the codebase, so the component displays the returned data generically.
